title: Ivy's compliance daylist: SOC2 evidence + vendor quicks
content:
Morning sprint notes (brain-dump)
Date: 2026-07-06
Owner: Ivy Patel (personal worklist)

Top goal: get vendor evidence for Vanta intake + finish Policy exceptions doc draft for legal review. Keep it lean — this is a personal checklist, not the final deliverable.

---
Quick context / priorities
- Auditor kickoff next Wednesday (informal) — want to have a clean evidence slate for access control, backups, and vendor attestations.
- Vanta flagged two missing items from last scan: 'Encryption at rest proof' (app servers) and 'Vendor contract with SOC2 clause' for LogStream.
- Legal needs policy-exceptions writeup for on-prem telemetry collectors by EOD Friday.

Daily TODO (priority order)
1) Vendor evidence: LogStream (high)
   - Ask Marco for the contract PDF (contract date + signature). If Marco out: use Legal search CON-LOGSTREAM-2024.
   - Quick checklist to capture for Vanta: contract (signed), data flow diagram (1 page screenshot), security questionnaire (if exists).
   - Upload to Drive -> shared_drives/company/security/vendor-evidence/LogStream (note: this is me copying to shared drive later).
   - Slack note draft to vendor: "Hi — can you confirm SOC2 + provide latest security questionnaire? Need signed contract page for our compliance intake."

2) Encryption at rest proof (medium)
   - Goal: produce a short artifact showing EBS encryption + KMS key arn used for prod GPU cluster.
   - Quick run command to capture: aws ec2 describe-volumes --filters Name=tag:Cluster,Values=prod-gpu --query 'Volumes[*].[VolumeId,Encrypted]'
   - If any unencrypted volumes: escalate to infra-team (tag: infra/ops) with immediate remediation ticket (JIRA-SEC-452).
   - Artifact: paste CLI output + screenshot of KMS key ARN from AWS console.

3) Policy exception draft for telemetry collectors (legal review) (high)
   - One-paragraph rationale, list of mitigations, proposed sunset date (90 days), monitoring plan.
   - Minimal headings: Background, Risk, Mitigations, Monitoring, Approval path.
   - Link to example: CON-SEC-EXCEPTION-TEMPLATE (Confluence).
   - Deliverable: short doc (<= 350 words) to hand to Priya by EOD Fri.

4) Evidence triage: backlog grooming (low-medium)
   - Quick scan of Vanta's outstanding 18 items. Tag ones that are truly missing vs. covered but unlinked.
   - Create a shared sheet for status (I will start one: "evidence-triage-ivy-2026-07").

Notes / snippets to paste into artifacts
- Evidence naming convention for upload: <control>-<evidence-type>-<YYYYMMDD>-<owner initials>.pdf (e.g., CC6-encryption-20260706-IP.pdf)
- Minimal metadata to include in each upload: control id, description, date generated, source (CLI/console/vendor), owner.

Unresolved questions / TODOs to chase
- Does LogStream have a SOC2 report or ISO? (ask Marco, also check vendor portal)
- Which KMS key is used by dedicated-gpu-prod autoscale group? (infra owner: @marco-diaz)
- Are telemetry collectors currently sending PII to external bucket? Quick grep in config repo: 's3_bucket.*telemetry'

Meeting prep (30-min sync with Marco @ 11:00)
- Agenda: contract PDF, where to pull vendor questionnaire, confirm whether they rotate keys quarterly.
- Desired outcomes: contract uploaded; vendor contact email; confirmation on SOC2/ISO existence.
- Quick Slack message to send before meeting: "Quick sync at 11 to grab LogStream contract + next steps for Vanta intake. Please have contract PDF or pointer ready."

Quick draft: Slack message to vendor (short)
"Hi — I'm Ivy on Redwood's compliance team. We're completing a SOC2 intake and need a copy of your most recent SOC2 report or a completed security questionnaire plus the signed contract page including data processing clauses. Can you provide via email or a secure link? Thanks!"

One-line artifacts to produce today (deliverables)
- contract_pdf_LogStream_20260706-IP.pdf (upload + link in Vanta)
- kms_encryption_evidence_20260706-IP.txt (CLI output)
- policy_exception_telemetry_20260709-IP.docx (first draft to Priya)

Quick commands / snippets (save these)
- EBS encryption check: aws ec2 describe-volumes --filters Name=tag:Cluster,Values=prod-gpu --query 'Volumes[*].[VolumeId,Encrypted]' --profile prod
- KMS keys list: aws kms list-keys --profile prod | jq '.Keys[] | .KeyId'
- Search repo for telemetry buckets: git grep -n "telemetry" -- config/ || true

Risk notes (for ticket)
- If vendor does not provide contract clause within 5 business days, escalate to Legal and change routing to non-prod for affected datasets.
- If unencrypted EBS found, immediate remediation: snapshot + create encrypted volume + attach; temporary downtime window required.

End-of-day quick log (to fill)
- What I completed: 
  - [ ] contract uploaded
  - [ ] CLI encryption proof collected
  - [ ] Policy draft sent to Priya
  - [ ] Vanta checklist updated

References to paste into Confluence/Jira later
- Confluence: CON-SEC-SOC2-2026 (SOC2 program overview)
- Jira: JIRA-SEC-452 (encryption remediation)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/389 (infra change for kms-tagging)

Notes to self (random)
- Keep artifacts small, auditors don't need 20-page PDFs for simple things. One clear screenshot + CLI output is usually fine.
- When in doubt, get a timestamped artifact (console screenshot with time visible).

End of page.

[meta: personal scratchpad — move final artifacts to shared_drives/company/security when ready.]
